0.original: Managingway looks both confused and concerned.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

25.original: Try to defeat Shakingway in a battle of /dance.

26.original: Try to defeat Shakingway in a battle of /dance again.

48.original: While most of our Ways are content with rhythmical hopping, Shakingway has recently expressed a desire to master the ways of “dance.”

49.original: As I understand it, mankind's myriad cultures are well versed in this activity, so I was hoping you might humor his request for a...dancing battle? I'm not entirely clear on the particulars.

52.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Our dancing friend Shakingway has been asking for you.

53.original: Might you spare him a moment? It seems he wishes to battle again.

54.original: You'll find him practicing in Bestways Burrow. I have no doubt he is itching to witness your “moves.”

55.original: Come one, come all! Challenge Shakingway and fall!

58.original: A challenge of dance? All right, very well! I'll dance you to death and send you to...uh...was it “hells”?

59.original: Aaah! It's you! Erm...<hex:02100103>Come again to see my moves? You will find me much improved!

60.original: At the musicking station, the fates will decide. On our battle I'll wager my name and my pride!

61.original: My dancing skill is second to none! You can show me your moves, but I've already won!

62.original: Shakingway is getting ahead of himself. Show him the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>dance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> of a real champion.

63.original: Whoa, what was that? Such beauty, such grace... Erm!<hex:02100103>Ha-ha-ha, your dance is weak! I'm still the dance master of whom all speak!

64.original: Shakingway doesn't acknowledge that movement as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>dance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Only <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>dance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will change his opinion of you.

65.original: What the─!? That was amazing! How did you─I-I mean!<hex:02100103>You were lucky! That was luck! Bet you can't do it again, you...puck?

66.original: If this is a dream, don't wake me... Ahem! I-I mean!<hex:02100103>Is that really the best you can do? Then do it again─but you can't, can you?

67.original: It seems you've caught Shakingway's attention. Show him your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>dance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> again for the win.

68.original: Lost your nerve? Don't want to play? The reigning champ is Shakingway!

69.original: Shakingway is gaining confidence again. Finish him by showing him your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>dance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

70.original: Ha! You only had a lucky streak─my sensational moves cannot be beat!

71.original: Shakingway doesn't acknowledge that movement as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>dance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and to make matters worse, he now derides you in slant rhyme. Demand his respect with an unparalleled display of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>dance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

73.original: How strange... Watching your dance has filled me with inner peace. I feel confident...courageous, even. A-Ahem!

74.original: Th-This isn't over! I may retreat, but next time I will not be beat!

75.original: I'll chase my dream till I'm king of the moon─I'll have my revenge! We'll meet again soon!

76.original: Ah, you're back. I just saw Shakingway dash past with tears in his eyes, so I assume you won your little bout?

77.original: Revenge, you say? Then it sounds as though we shall require more of your time in the future.

78.original: I do hate to trouble you, but sometimes I wonder if he isn't simply in need of a playfellow. Thank you for your kindness, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.
